headline: No API change affects the bot today; the ideas make you write a one-line plan before each trade, make a losing coin wait for a fresh setup instead of a timer, and have you pick one trading hour in the morning brief.

ideas.title: /plan before every entry
ideas.why: Before you open a trade, send '/plan SOL long stop 142.1'. The guard checks each new position against it: no plan in the last 10 minutes, or a stop that doesn't match, and you get an 'unplanned' alert. /week shows planned vs unplanned P&L.

ideas.title: After a loss, the coin waits for a new setup
ideas.why: Revenge trades are usually the same coin, same idea, minutes later. After a loss, mark that coin 'used' on the scanner and in the guard until its 15m EMA 9/21 crosses back and re-aligns: a real new setup, not just 15 minutes passing.

ideas.title: Pick your one trading hour at 08:00
ideas.why: The brief asks you to tap one window for today (09–10, 10–11 or 11–12) inside your 12:00 cutoff. The guard warns on any entry outside it. Naming a narrow window ahead of time is a planning prompt that has raised follow-through in a field study.
